title: P1 submit_activity: response
description: Outcome of an activity: a task (new, or the same one on a repeat of the same update, IDM-5), ignored (the activity did not become a task, for example it came from a non-principal or is not a command) or a ready code answer that the channel shows itself. Code chose the task type (IDN-6). Denials: identity_unknown, not_ready.

existing.description: Only task: the same update has already produced this task.

reason.description: Only ignored: why, for example not_subject.

text.description: Only reply: a ready code text from the text catalog.
